messages.body:
Infra changes (startup template, machine type) still cost downtime: they need a boot or VM replacement, unlike app deploys which are staged in place (#38). Now that state lives in the repo (#35), worker VMs are cattle — so:

## Design: blue/green VM pair, IP-flip promotion
- `terraform apply` with a standby flag provisions a second worker VM from the new template while the active one serves
- promotion script: health-check standby → sync /var/lib/caddy (warm TLS; LE cannot issue pre-flip) → **stop services on old first** (single-writer refs, SPEC §5) → move the static IP → start services on standby (state recovered by fetching refs/particle/*) → destroy old
- downtime = IP reattach (~10–30s); SSE auto-reconnects; steady-state cost stays one VM

Also fold in (batched, one boot): redeploy health-gate before writing installed-sha; webhook listener body cap + threading; CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/opt/particle/cache so app deploys rebuild only our crates (~1 min instead of 6–8).

Endgame alternative when the API separates from the appender: MIG + GCLB + managed certs.

title: P3.BLUEGREEN — infra deploys without downtime (VM pair + IP flip)
